summary: Verified payroll group isolation between 'karyawan' (Herliana) and 'staff' (Nofia). All 7 pytest backend tests passed and frontend flows verified end-to-end. Nofia's staff PIN was set to 4321 (as authorized). Herliana's karyawan PIN was NEVER read or modified and remains set. critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/hrd.py is 1372 lines — recommend splitting (pin, payslips, email, settings) into submodules for maintainability.

_pfilter treats missing/None payroll_group as 'karyawan' (line ~133-134). This is safe today but any future 'staff' import that forgets to set payroll_group would silently leak into karyawan. Consider making import validation reject slips without payroll_group explicitly set.
